captions.detailed: A through-wall hotel-style air conditioning unit in a neutral beige casing. Its front panel features a wide, dark-vented air intake grille on the left and a vertical control panel on the right housing four individual light-blue push buttons. Below the main intake is a long horizontal discharge flap that pivots outward. The four control buttons can depress independently along a prismatic axis, and the air discharge flap rotates on a horizontal revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a through-wall air conditioning unit. The assembly must feature a main rectangular beige chassis, a wide horizontal intake grille with multiple dark slats, a lower horizontal air discharge flap that pivots on a revolute joint, and a recessed control panel containing four small prismatic blue buttons that can depress independently.
captions.factory: Construct the main air conditioner body using a boolean subtraction of a hollowed Box primitive for the chassis. Model the intake grille by repeating thin horizontal box slats. Create the air discharge flap as a long, thin horizontal panel and attach it via a revolute joint. Build the control panel as a recessed rectangular cavity, and populate it with four small, vertically aligned prismatic box buttons, each connected via an independent prismatic joint allowing translation along the depth axis.
